invariant_bindings.invariant_text: Total rows written across all `add_sheet`/`write_rows` calls MUST NEVER exceed `max_rows`; exceeding the cap raises ValueError BEFORE any partial data is written past the limit.
`create_workbook()` MUST raise ImportError with an actionable message ('pip install openpyxl') when openpyxl is unavailable — never silently returns a broken stub.
Rows MUST be written in batches of `chunk_size`; given n rows, at most ceil(n / chunk_size) flush points occur (bounded memory footprint).
